method: independent second check; every stage read in full; no numeric items in this set (num items: 0); encyclopedia titles verified; answer-option lengths measured by script; rubric keywords scanned for over-short substrings

corrections.what: missing Wikipedia title 'Aboriginal Australian creation' replaced with 'The Dreaming'
missing title 'Aboriginal Australian peoples' replaced with 'Indigenous Australians'
missing title 'Shakespearean romance' replaced with 'Shakespeare's late romances'
'the world's oldest continuing storytelling traditions' softened to 'among the world's oldest' (superlative not safely provable)
Homer 'written down about the 8th century BCE' softened to 'probably set down in writing around the 8th century BCE' (date of writing is debated)
Huckleberry Finn '1884' made '1884 in Britain, 1885 in the United States'
Alarinjo 'grew in the 17th-18th century' replaced with 'developed in the Yoruba kingdoms several centuries ago' (dating uncertain)
match pair Assonance='the moan of doves' is a weak example of assonance; replaced with 'the rain in Spain stays mainly in the plain'

answer-length giveaway: in the bulk rewrite the correct option had become conspicuously the shortest (distractors padded with trailing clauses; correct 40-60 percent of their length). Correct options lengthened with accurate, non-leading wording; share of mc items where the key is the shortest fell from about 33 percent to about 19 percent in l4-l6. No wrong option was found to be correct or arguably correct.

substring matching let over-short keywords pass any answer ('wit' in 'with', 'as' in 'has', 'is' in 'this', 'we', 'lie' in 'believe', 'act' in 'fact', 'how' in 'show', 'age', 'old', 'end', 'one', 'no', 'but', 'law', 'war', 'all', 'do', 'pun', 'cut'); replaced by longer, still natural stems

needsSpecialist.what: 'about 37 plays' (Shakespeare canon count varies 36-39 depending on collaborations) and '154 sonnets published in 1609' (the Quarto was possibly unauthorised); both are standard textbook figures and left as is
Middleton's revisions to Macbeth and Wilkins on Pericles are mainstream attributions but still scholarly claims; a Shakespeare specialist may wish to confirm wording

needsSpecialist.at: l2 s9, l3 s9, l5 s9 (Aboriginal, Māori, Polynesian material)
needsSpecialist.what: wording about Dreaming stories, Rangi/Papa and Māui follows widely published accounts; a cultural reviewer from the relevant communities should confirm the framing and which tales are suitable to retell
